1141:List and read the Cloud Skills in your hosted MCPJam projects. These commands exist to close a gap: three flags across the CL
I take a skill ID (`eval run --compose-skill`, `eval cases run --compose-skill`, `environments ensure-adhoc --skill`) and until no
w there was no way to discover those IDs without opening the web app. Authoring stays in the app — these commands are read-only.
1566:### `cloud eval create`
1573:| `--file <path>` | No | Path to a **create-API JSON** body (or `-` for stdin). A versioned suite file (`schemaVersion: "1"`)
belongs on `eval run --file` |
1579:| `--client <id-or-name...>` | No | Clients to attach the suite to (overrides the file). Without one the suite lists no clien
t, and `eval run --client` has nothing to select |
1590:### `cloud eval run`
1592:Start an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a versioned suite file and run it. Provide **either** `--suite` **or** `--f
ile`, not both.
1594:By default the command prints a launch receipt and returns immediately. `--wait` polls every launched run to a terminal state
1596:**Exit codes (`--wait` only).** Without `--wait` this command's exit code is unchanged: `0` on any launch, `1` on a partial o
r wholly failed fan-out. `--wait` owns a separate six-code contract — a caller who asked this process to sit and watch a run to co
mpletion is asking it to say how the run went:
1602:| `2` | Usage error — bad flags, `--reporter`/`--out` without `--wait`, or an invalid suite file (after auth, before any serv
er/model work) |
1609:This six-code contract is new and deliberately **different** from `eval gate`'s four codes below — see that command's own doc
for why the two are not unified. An invalid suite file exits **2** either way — `eval validate` still exits 1 for the same contra
ct failure, because it is a verdict on the file and this command is not.
1613:| `--suite <id-or-name>` | Yes, unless `--file` | Eval suite name or ID |
1614:| `--file <path>` | Yes, unless `--suite` | Versioned suite file to upload and run (`.yaml` or `.json`, or `-` for stdin) |
1628:| `--match-options <json>` | No | Tool-call match options for this run, e.g. `'{"toolCallOrder":"exact"}'` |
1629:| `--idempotency-key <key>` | No | Retry key for a lost launch response. For `--file`, a fresh key is minted and printed on e
very invocation when this flag is omitted; supply the printed key to replay the same run instead of starting a new one |
1630:| `--wait` | No | Wait for every launched run to reach a terminal status |
1631:| `--wait-timeout <ms>` | No | Maximum wait time (default 2100000); requires `--wait` |
1632:| `--reporter <json-summary\|junit-xml\|html>` | No | Write the completed structured report to stdout; requires `--wait`. `ht
ml` is a self-contained decision summary + failures page — traces/parity/history are not included. |
1633:| `--out <path>` | No | Atomically write the completed report to a file; defaults to `json-summary`, or uses `--reporter` whe
n present; requires `--wait` |
1642:| `--compose-host-servers` | No | **No longer supported** — rejected. An eval run takes its servers from a server group alone
; use `--compose-server` or `--compose-server-group` |
